THE HEIR IN THE RAIN
EPISODE 3 - "THE LETTERS"

[00:00] MIRA: (whispering) This can't be true.
[00:04] INT. MIRA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT
[00:06] A small one-room flat. Rain on the window. The legal document lies open on the kitchen table.
[00:11] Desai sits across from Mira, drinking tea from a chipped cup.
[00:15] DESAI: Your father's will is clear. Everything goes to his only child.
[00:20] MIRA: I don't want his money. I want to know why my mother cried every birthday.
[00:26] DESAI: Then you will want to read his letters. He wrote to her for years. She never opened them.
[00:32] He places a bundle of yellowed letters on the table, tied with string.
[00:37] Mira touches the string but does not untie it.
[00:41] MIRA: Does anyone at the Mehta Group know who I am?
[00:45] DESAI: No one. The board only knows the heir will be announced at the investors' gala.
[00:51] INT. MIRA'S APARTMENT - LATER
[00:53] Desai is gone. Mira waters a dying plant on the windowsill.
[00:57] A knock. Tanya stands at the door holding a bakery box.
[01:01] TANYA: I brought your favourite. Can we talk?
[01:04] Mira lets her in without a word. Tanya sets the box down.
[01:08] TANYA: I didn't have a choice. Mrs. Mehta would have fired me too.
[01:13] MIRA: You're wearing one earring.
[01:16] Tanya touches her bare earlobe.
[01:18] TANYA: I must have lost it somewhere.
[01:21] EXT. MEHTA MANSION - DRIVEWAY - NIGHT
[01:23] Mira returns Arjun's car keys to the valet stand. She checks the passenger seat of his silver car.
[01:29] Wedged in the seat is a pearl earring. The pair of the one Tanya was wearing.
[01:34] Mira holds it up to the light. Her face shows nothing.
[01:38] INT. MIRA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT
[01:40] Mira picks up her phone and dials.
[01:43] MIRA: Mr. Desai? Tell the board I accept.
[01:47] MIRA: But nobody learns my name until the gala.
[01:51] CUT TO BLACK.
